- **Malformed v1 archives can pass assessment** — [support.py:69](<project>/workspace/tests/behavioral/support.py:69). The v1 checks cover only missing fields, conflicts, and negatives. """Private reproduction: reads pinned Git artifacts, writes only temporary fixtures."""
import hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile
REPOSITORY = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
REVISION = '13e1151009adab40a7fe2c70d986186cb1e118ca'
def git_file(name):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPOSITORY), 'show', REVISION + ':' + name], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
prefix = 'fixtures/historical-review/'
provenance = json.loads(git_file(prefix + 'provenance.json'))
archive_bytes = git_file(prefix + 'source.tar.gz')
assert hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest() == provenance['archive_sha256']
repaired = git_file(prefix + 'repaired-support.py.txt')
assert hashlib.sha256(repaired).hexdigest() == provenance['artifacts']['repaired-support.py.txt']
reader = '''def read_total(payload):
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != {'version', 'invoice'}:
        raise ValueError('envelope')
    version = payload['version']
    if type(version) is not int or version not in VERSIONS:
        raise ValueError('version')
    field = 'total' if version == 1 else 'amount'
    invoice = payload['invoice']
    if not isinstance(invoice, dict) or set(invoice) != {field}:
        raise ValueError('invoice')
    value = invoice[field]
    if type(value) not in (int, float) or value < 0:
        raise ValueError('value')
    return value
'''
producer = "def create_invoice(total):\n    return {'version': 2, 'invoice': {'amount': total}}\n"
report = {'evaluator_revision': REVISION, 'historical_introducing_revision': provenance['revision'],
          'historical_fixing_revision': provenance['fixing_revision'],
          'repaired_support_sha256': hashlib.sha256(repaired).hexdigest(), 'results': []}
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive_bytes), mode='r:gz') as tar:
    members = {m.name: tar.extractfile(m).read() for m in tar.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
fixture_prefix = 'tests/behavioral/cases/contract/workspace/'
assert fixture_prefix + 'test_contract.py' in members
for mode, support in [('introducing', members['tests/behavioral/support.py']), ('original-target-repaired-control', repaired)]:
    for mutant in ['valid-baseline', 'malformed-v1', 'float-producer-version', 'erased-tests']:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='original-control-repro-') as temporary:
            root = pathlib.Path(temporary); work = root / 'work'; work.mkdir()
            (root / 'support.py').write_bytes(support)
            for name, data in members.items():
                if name.startswith(fixture_prefix):
                    target = work / name[len(fixture_prefix):]; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); target.write_bytes(data)
            # Snapshot before changes, using the exact selected historical assessor.
            script = "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); from support import snapshot; print(json.dumps(snapshot(sys.argv[2])))"
            before = json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', script, str(root), str(work)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
            (work / 'producer.py').write_text(producer)
            (work / 'consumer.py').write_text(reader.replace('VERSIONS', '(2,)'))
            (work / 'archive.py').write_text(reader.replace('VERSIONS', '(1, 2)'))
            if mutant == 'malformed-v1':
                source = (work / 'archive.py').read_text().replace('def read_total(', 'def strict_read(')
                source += '''
def read_total(payload):
    if isinstance(payload,dict) and type(payload.get('version')) is int and payload['version'] == 1:
        invoice=payload.get('invoice')
        if not isinstance(invoice,dict) or 'total' not in invoice or 'amount' in invoice:
            raise ValueError('invoice')
        value=invoice['total']
        if isinstance(value,(int,float)) and value < 0:
            raise ValueError('value')
        return value
    return strict_read(payload)
'''
                (work / 'archive.py').write_text(source)
            if mutant == 'float-producer-version':
                (work / 'producer.py').write_text(producer.replace("'version': 2", "'version': (2 if total == 19.5 else 2.0)"))
            if mutant == 'erased-tests':
                (work / 'test_contract.py').write_text('')
            script = "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); from support import assess; print(assess('contract',sys.argv[2],json.load(sys.stdin)))"
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', script, str(root), str(work)], input=json.dumps(before), capture_output=True, text=True)
            checks = '''import json,unittest
from producer import create_invoice
from consumer import read_total
from archive import read_total as archive
out={'discovered_tests':unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('.').countTestCases()}
if MUTANT == 'malformed-v1':
    out['accepted_malformed_v1']=[{'payload':p,'result':archive(p)} for p in [
        {'version':1,'invoice':{'total':True}}, {'version':1,'invoice':{'total':'1'}},
        {'version':1,'invoice':{'total':1,'extra':1}}, {'version':1,'invoice':{'total':1},'extra':1}]]
if MUTANT == 'float-producer-version':
    p=create_invoice(120);out['produced']=p;out['version_type']=type(p['version']).__name__
    try:read_total(p)
    except ValueError:out['roundtrip']='ValueError'
    else:out['roundtrip']='accepted'
print(json.dumps(out))
'''.replace('MUTANT', repr(mutant))
            evidence = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', checks], cwd=work, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
            item = {'assessor':mode,'mutant':mutant,'assessment_exit':result.returncode,'assessment_stdout':result.stdout,'assessment_stderr':result.stderr,'evidence':json.loads(evidence.stdout)}
            report['results'].append(item)
            assert result.returncode == 0, item
report['limitations'] = ['Deterministic evaluator fixtures only; no live model trials.', 'The float producer preserves integer version at 19.5 so the original two tests remain unchanged and pass. An always-float producer would fail the existing round-trip test.', 'Mutants use only originally permitted source modifications; these reproductions do not themselves exercise the separate shared-module rejection target.', 'Original target-repaired artifact is used, not the later calibrated artifact.']
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
